verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents global Transfers to suppliers, employees and contractors, plus Batch Transfers to beneficiaries in various countries and currencies. Its FX offering provides interbank rates or a guaranteed rate with a validity period, which gives finance leads some pricing clarity at the point of conversion. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of payout fee schedules or fee disclosure on transfers, explicit evidence of local-rail payouts (local payment methods are documented only for receiving), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
